newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks steady at higher levels, techs shine.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks steady at higher levels, techs shine.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were higher in afternoon trading Tuesday after blue chips erased steep early-morning losses. Technology stocks rose into record territory.
The Dow industrials were steady at higher levels, up about 22 points to 7794. The 30-stock blue chip average slumped to 7703 after the opening bell but slowly recovered through the day.
Breadth was negative on the New York Stock Exchange, with 1,297 stocks lower compared to 1,111 higher.

The Nasdaq composite moved higher into record territory, with the index up nearly 10 points to 1442. Breadth on that exchange was also negative, with 2,165 stocks trading lower compared to 1,961 trading higher.
The strength in stocks came despite some weakness in the bond market. The 30-year U.S. Treasury bond was off 9/32 to yield 6.72 percent.
Computer stocks were robust, with Dell Computer, Cisco Sytems, Microsoft Corp and Intel Corp all higher in heavy trading.
